newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank of Portugal denies it sold gold.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Portugal denies it sold gold.

text.p: The Portuguese central bank denied that it had sold gold from its reserves after an authoritative research group said gold sales from the official sector had accelerated in the second half of 1996.
"Nothing has changed. The Bank formally denies this," a spokesman told Reuters.

He had been asked to comment on a report by Gold Fields Mineral Services (GFMS), which said that the gold sales were a major factor weakening prices, which have fallen 3-1/2 percent since the start of the year.
Last month the spokesman denied persistent talk in the gold market that a central bank, possibly Portugal, had sold bullion out of its gold reserves. --Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254
